run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers script with a config yaml file to compute dataset mean and std
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a config and linear reference file to fit normalizers using element references
create_normalizers_checkpoint: create a normalizers checkpoint file by fitting dataset mean and std from a training config
fit_normalizers_for_targets: fit normalizers for specified targets using a training dataset with configurable batch size and workers
review_fit_norms_function: review the fit_norms function to understand how it loads datasets and saves normalizer checkpoints
